newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-BI downgraded to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BI downgraded to neutral.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw analyst Jennifer Childe said she downgraded BI Inc to neutral from buy.
-- Shares in the company were up 3/16 to 6-9/16. The company makes electronic ankle bracelets for persons on parole or probation that allow law enforcement authorities to monitor their movements.

-- "Last week, BI pre-released disappointing first fiscal quarter EPS of $0.02-$0.04 per share. Following several subsequent conversations with the company, we are downgrading our recommendation to a neutral and lowering our fiscal 1997 and fiscal 1998 estimates by $0.18 and $0.19," Childe said.
-- She said she now projects fiscal 1997 earnings of $0.34 per share and fiscal 1998 earnings of $0.50 per share.
